tools.name: paid_structured_answer
tools.description: Use when you have a free-form multilingual question and want deterministic Store SKU selection with x402 USDC delivery. Do not use for free signature verification (use verify_risk_object) or domain-locked single-country queries (use geopolitics_query, macro_fx_query, or critical_minerals_query). Read-only; never authorizes execution.

max_age_seconds.description: Optional maximum acceptable intelligence age in seconds before rejecting stale state.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Use when asking a concise English natural-language question (up to 1000 chars) naming one or more unambiguous countries without choosing a SKU. Do not use for directional trade corridors (use corridor_risk) or pre-payment policy gates (use risk_gate_decision_context). Paid via x402 USDC; never charges when unavailable.

tools.name: geopolitics_query
tools.description: Geomacro Geopolitics Agent: use when asking a focused geopolitics or conflict question for a single country (ISO3). Do not use for cross-domain summaries (use country_risk or three_domain_state) or cross-border corridors (use corridor_risk). Live retrieval is no-charge until commercially verified; published_only uses x402 USDC.

tools.name: country_risk
tools.description: Use when you need the current derived risk state for a single country across selected domains without writing a free-form question. Do not use for bilateral corridors (use corridor_risk) or change attribution (use change_since_last_verified or why_changed). Paid via x402 USDC; never returns raw upstream data.

tools.name: corridor_risk
tools.description: Use when assessing directional cross-border risk from an origin country to a destination country (trade, supply chain, or settlement corridor). Do not use for single-country queries (use country_risk). Paid via x402 USDC; read-only.

tools.description: Use when checking what materially changed since the previous published verified state for a country or corridor. Do not use if you only need the current baseline snapshot (use country_risk or three_domain_state) or causal drivers (use why_changed). Paid via x402 USDC.
